note: group math is the closest of the five atlas groups; the page is chemistry geometry

description.zh: 价层电子对互相排斥，N 个区域排成最散的队形，孤对更胖、挤得更开：水分子两个孤对把成键对挤弯成约 104.5°，形状不对称所以有极性；二氧化碳没有孤对、排成直线，对称抵消就没有极性。教学简化模型，不含轨道。
description.en: Valence electron pairs repel, so N regions spread out as far as possible, with lone pairs fatter and pushing harder: water's two lone pairs bend its bonds to about 104.5°, and the lopsided shape gives polarity, while carbon dioxide has no lone pairs, lines up straight, and its symmetry cancels polarity. A teaching simplification without orbitals.

reason.zh: 分子极性是各键偶极的矢量和，形状对称时和为零。
reason.en: Molecular polarity is the vector sum of bond dipoles, which vanishes when the shape is symmetric.

reason.zh: 电子对在球面上被 1/r² 的静电斥力推开，排成最低能量的队形。
reason.en: Electron pairs on the sphere are pushed apart by a 1/r² electrostatic repulsion and settle into the lowest-energy arrangement.

label.en: Force is the downhill slope of energy

reason.zh: 第 1 步每个点沿能量下降最快的方向走一小步，力就是排斥能的负梯度（导数的推广）。
reason.en: In step 1 each point steps along the direction of steepest energy descent; the force is the negative gradient of the repulsion energy, a generalised derivative.

ask.zh: 价层电子对互相排斥——N 个区域怎样排布才最散？孤对为什么“更胖”？
ask.en: Valence electron pairs repel each other — how do N regions arrange to spread out most? Why are lone pairs "fatter"?

ask.zh: 水分子有两个孤对——孤对挤压成键对，键角是变大还是变小？变成多少度左右？
ask.en: Water has two lone pairs — do they squeeze the bonding pairs to a bigger or smaller angle? About how many degrees?

ask.zh: 形状不对称，水分子就有极性——极性和键角有什么关系？
ask.en: Water's lopsided shape gives it polarity — how is polarity tied to the bond angle?

reveal.zh: 电子对互斥让四个区域排成四面体，两个孤对更胖、挤压成键对，水就弯成约 104.5°，不对称的形状带来极性。
reveal.en: Repulsion arranges four regions tetrahedrally; the two fatter lone pairs squeeze the bonding pairs, bending water to about 104.5°, and that lopsided shape makes it polar.
